entities.summary: Will Wood is an American singer-songwriter and comedian. Wood has released four studio albums: Everything Is a Lot (2015) and Self-ish (2016), The Normal Album (2020), and "In case I make it," (2022), as well as one comedy special, Slouching Towards Branson (2025).
